design: Six operation families x8 declared items x task/copy-first-token/constant-yes controls x2 instruction verbs x2 answer suffixes. First4 items discovery, last4 transfer, frozen before inference. No selection by competence. Constant candidate metric is trivial and not interpreted.
limitations: Small synthetic diagnostic suite; reused familiar words, not blind unseen lexical replication. Controls change instruction length and semantics. Addition copy uses first number; agreement copy uses The; report separately. Single target-token next-token competence, not full generated-answer accuracy.
